findings.F1: The book's gain is mostly timing, not the market's own rise. Of its mean daily return of +0.0651 % (t 2.32 over 1,449 days), the market's own rise carries +0.0167 % and timing carries +0.0485 %. Timing is positive on all six coins, from +0.016 % a day on LTC to +0.086 % on ETH.
findings.F2: The gain does not come from the idea's grading. Within rising-calm bars with the close above its 20-day average, the 5-day slope of the unusual return on the distance has t 0.21 (142 cases, 51 days). Trades entered on the lowest third of forecasts earn a mean of +7.45 % (206 trades), against +2.03 % for the highest third (202 trades).
findings.F3: What carries the book is being long in a rising calm market while the close is above its 20-day average at all. In rising-calm bars, the 5-day unusual move is +2.94 % when the close is above the average (142 cases) and -1.19 % when it is at or below it (36 cases).
findings.F4: The book is concentrated in one year and a few trades.
findings.F5: The graded continuation shows better at a 10-day horizon than at the plan's 5 days.
findings.F6: The strongest graded relation between the signed distance to the 20-day average and the move that follows is in choppy markets, a profile the book never trades.
findings.F7: The brief's own giveback barely shows. In rising agitated bars above the average, the slope is negative but cannot be told from 0: t -0.14 at 5 days (85 cases) and t -1.34 at 10 days (34 cases).

ideas.idea: In a rising, calm market, the further a coin's close stands above its 20-day average price, the more the coin rises over the next 10 days; the further it stands below, the less it rises.
ideas.consequence: In a calm rising market, a trader holds a stretch above the average longer than a week, and a close sitting below the average is a reason to stay out.
ideas.name: calm rise stretch ten days

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, the further a coin's close stands below its 20-day average price, the more it falls over the next 10 days; the further it stands above, the more it rises.
ideas.consequence: In a market with no trend over two months, a trader follows the coin's distance from its 20-day average instead of fading it, including on the short side when the coin is far below.
ideas.name: choppy market distance continuation
